Name: Feed More Animal Crackers
Author: advanlsdnfa
Description:
[size=6]Feed More Animal Crackers[/size]

[size=2]Lets you feed more animal crackers to animals.  Also works on fish ponds.

[/size]For example, if you give a chicken 5 animal crackers, it should produce 6 eggs. If you give a fish pond 5 animal crackers, it should produce 6 times whatever the original stack size was (so if it was supposed to produce 3 roe it would produce 18 roe).

[size=4]Console Commands
[/size][size=2][font=Courier New]gellingly.remove_crackers[/font] - Remove all golden crackers from this animal or fish pond.  Only works if the animal menu (menu that opens when you right click on a animal and tells you what their mood is) or fish pond menu (menu that opens if you right click on a fish pond that tells how many fish are in that pond) is open.

[/size]Source code: https://github.com/gellingly/stardewmods

Manifest.Name: FeedMoreAnimalCrackers
Manifest.Description: Give multiple animal crackers to an animal
